meta.title: Audio Noise Remover - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Remove background noise from audio using a noise gate. Adjustable threshold.
mergeAtLeast: Add at least {count} files to merge
clippingWarning: Volume above 100% may cause clipping and distortion in the exported audio.
webmNote: WebM/Opus uses browser MediaRecorder — bitrate and sample rate are browser-controlled.
gateDesc: Silences signals below the threshold. Attack controls how quickly the gate opens; Release controls how quickly it closes.
rnnoiseDesc: Deep learning model trained on voice. Removes background noise while preserving speech clarity.
rnnoiseSrWarning: Your audio is {sr} kHz. RNNoise works best at 48 kHz — it will be automatically resampled.
rnnoiseFirstRun: First run downloads AI model (~100 KB)
steps_audio-denoise_1Desc: Select an audio file with background noise — hiss, hum, fan noise, or static. The file loads in your browser for local noise profile analysis.
steps_audio-denoise_2Desc: Set the reduction strength. Start with a moderate level to avoid artifacts. Higher levels remove more noise but may affect voice clarity. Preview the result.
steps_audio-denoise_3Desc: Click Denoise to clean your audio. Download the processed file — ideal for podcasts, voice recordings, video voiceovers, and meeting recordings.
desc: Remove background noise from audio using a noise gate. Adjustable threshold.
hint: Click or drag audio files here (MP3 / WAV / OGG / AAC / FLAC / M4A, ≤50MB)
ui.102: Audio playback is not supported in this browser
